text: A personal assistant being engineered around durable state, evidence, bounded agency and continuity across replaceable models and devices. This plate maps the current source; deployment and hardware validation remain separate claims.
CURRENT = implemented source. EXPERIMENTAL = measurement in progress. PLANNED = specified or proposed, not established in operation.
Difficulty chooses a profile; interactive turns prefer measured latency.
Persona, recent dialogue, live mode and selected facts beside the question.
Privacy, credential redaction and cost rules precede provider attempts.
Reply to the owner; capture utterances asynchronously and record misses.
A model names a known capability and arguments; the proposal grants no authority.
Evaluate scoped grants, argument-sensitive levels and ceilings; ask when required.
Re-check authority; checkpoint file changes and record external effects before acting.
Feed observations to the next step. Check effects where an independent verifier exists.
A replaceable inference service. It generates answers or proposes steps; its output is not permission.
Stored facts and their provenance. The log preserves history; the graph makes it selectable.
The bounded material supplied now: rules, evidence, recent dialogue and the current request.
Concrete adapters that read or change the world. Arguments determine their required authority.
A bounded task process with a purpose and tool scope. Advice returns with external-content taint.
The native island and home, speech and typed scenes. They expose state and receive the owner.
The runtime joins intake, models, memory and actions, while a separate loop evaluates world state.

L3 is the append-only event log. A fact is written there first; its returned sequence becomes the provenance pointer in L2, a SQLite graph of entities, facts and edges. L1 is the context rendered for a turn.

Selection uses FTS5 + a graph walk bounded at depth 3, then authority and recency. Block A carries a stable persona and index; block B places up to five relevant facts next to the question. Budget cuts and unresolved source pointers are reported.
The knowledge map navigates to hash-checked source spans; a map summary is not evidence. Compaction reprojects from L3. Erasing L2 does not destroy L3 history. No embedding store is used.
A capability name is insufficient: the same command tool can inspect a directory or destroy it. VESPER resolves authority from the actual arguments and the source of the instruction.
E: effective level. G: grant maximum. D: declared argument level. C: context-trust ceiling. M: owner-mode ceiling. A: authorization-strength ceiling. Levels are ordered L0 through L5.

This is an upper bound, not the whole permit: expiry, target scope, lease epoch, required level and further boundary checks still apply. Retrieved content stays tainted through summaries and caches. An advisor may add STOP; it cannot manufacture consent.

Host probes and agenda bridges supply observations. Facts expire to UNKNOWN; stale values do not masquerade as current ones. The deterministic trigger evaluator cannot call a model. Models can help carry out a decision after it fires.

Live wiring includes fact expiry, memory drift, contradiction handling, map staleness and due agenda items. Interruption budgets decide when to surface non-alarm work. A fresh external enable token gates autonomous actuation.

Events use HLC = (physical_ms, logical, node_id), ordered lexicographically: physical time, then a logical counter, then a node tie-breaker. Wall-clock arrival order cannot supersede a fact. Consumers must declare idempotency keys.

CURRENT Typed input, on-device English recognition, a local wake-word listener and Fn activation. Darija transcription uses permitted remote suppliers; speech uses provider routing or local synthesis, with degradations reported.

Application and window adapters read, write, move and inspect. Accessibility actions re-resolve an element and check its role and label before touching it. UI-tree access is limited to the showing Desktop. Camera identity remains PLANNED.

CURRENT Python core; SQLite persistence; Swift/AppKit host; Metal face and ambience beneath WebKit HTML/CSS/JS. The app launches its bundled runtime. Five physical stores separate log, audit, tombstones, state and workspace.

Supply contracts name Cloudflare, Groq, Gemini, Ollama and Mistral routes, plus purpose-specific voice and agent suppliers. These are configured candidates, not guaranteed availability. A bounded stdio MCP client is built; live server wiring is not established here.

CURRENT Placement and survival decisions use measured capability profiles and trust constraints. Network trust can only weaken node trust. The dedicated segment remains unattested; deployment is not a demonstrated roaming fabric.

EXPERIMENTAL Local inference is profiled with llama.cpp. The recorded node-1 Qwen3-8B Q4_K_M run sustained 45.8 tok/s (b10405-e79e4bf66, Vulkan; median of 3 x 10-minute runs, 2026-08-17). This is throughput, not conversational latency.

PLANNED / OPEN Camera identity; cross-site connectivity; remote wake and service dormancy; multi-model residency; system widgets. SPIKE-002 still owes the full voice-latency chain. SPIKE-013 is measuring home-composite cost.
